title: Nutty Chewy Argentinian Coconut Empanadas
description: Light, nutty empanadas with a chewy oat‑almond crust, flavored with cumin and paprika and baked to a golden finish.
instructions: In a large bowl whisk together flour, oats, ground almonds, baking powder and a pinch of salt.
Add the melted coconut oil and unsweetened coconut milk, mixing until a smooth dough forms.
Cover the bowl with a damp towel and let the dough rest for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Divide the dough into 8 equal portions and roll each into a 7‑inch circle on a lightly floured surface.
Optional: spread a thin layer of sautéed onion, cumin, paprika and parsley over half the dough circles; fold the other half over so they form a semi‑circle and seal the edges with a fork.
Place each empanada on a parchment‑lined baking sheet, brush the tops with a little coconut oil.
Bake in a preheated 220 °C oven for 20 minutes, until golden and puffed.
Remove from the oven and let cool on a rack for 5 minutes before serving.
Repeat with remaining dough, using the same baking sheet if room permits.
Serve warm as a snack or light appetizer.
